title: A site's presentation drift is said once a conversation
steps: S1: two contract inspects and an apply on a Joomla site whose answers carry the same 17 PRESENTATION_DRIFT warnings, the apply one more.
S3: an answer with a LENGTH_RATIO warning beside a drift line.
expect: S1: the first inspect says 17 lines; the second one folded line with said:17; the apply the new line whole and the 17 folded.
S3: the LENGTH_RATIO warning is never folded, and the answer object is never changed.
evidence: Issue #258: 17,874 of 22,425 characters of a phone-number turn's contract answers were the same drift warnings

tests: a site’s presentation drift is said once a conversation, a new line whole, the rest as one count (#258)
